payload.text: ALI 0 Analytical Laboratories Inc. Since 1971 Analytical Laboratories Inc. has been serving the Treasure Valley since 1971. We have a full service, certified environmental laboratory able to perform a variety of scientific services and testing. ALI has a dedicated staff working to ensure that your sample is completed in a prompt and professional manner. Our experience and knowledge has made us one of the leading laboratories in Idaho. Full Service Environmental Laboratory EPA Certified Drinking Water Analysis Wastewater Analysis Food and Crop Analysis Fuel Analysis Soil Analysis Deicer Analysis Whole Effluent Toxicity Testing Sampling Services GSA-Mandated Testing View Pricing Testing Departments Microbiology Environmental Chemistry Fuels Metals Bio-Monitoring Organics Learn more about our staff Professional Affiliations American Association for Laboratory Accreditation (ISO 17025) (A2LA) Association of Official Analytical Chemists (AOAC) Idaho Environmental Health Association (IEHA) Institute of Food Technologies (IFT) Idaho Private Laboratories Association (IPLA) Idaho Rural Water Association (IRWA) We offer sampling services! Learn More Find out more about Whole Effluent Toxicity (WET) Testing Locate us: 1804 N. 33rd St. Boise, ID 83703 Hours of Operation: Monday-Friday: 07:30AM to 05:30PM. Saturday: 08:00AM to 04:00PM. Closed on Sundays. Click Here if you have any questions or concerns. Please take a minute to fill out our short survey . Thank you!
